selection: Next four unused ferry archive filenames after the prior four; chosen before trace values or replay
memory: Sample whole isolated Chrome process-tree RSS every 2 s, JS heap separately. Simulator also reports estimated compressed-media backlog; it is not browser memory.
training_gate: Do not train unless 60 s passes every new simulator and native timing/completion gate. Memory suitability still needs an explicit device budget; no budget is assumed.
limitations: Same silent VOD and ferry route; historical observed-goodput traces with assumed80ms RTT
Frozen model trained at 30 s cap; 60 s is an untrained context
Native player has no recovery; raw partial runs must remain marked partial
Browser RSS includes runtime/codecs; process-tree sums can count shared pages more than once
No target-device memory budget supplied; measurement is not a deployment approval
